articles.headline: From Evidence to Action: Preventing Vaccine-Preventable Disease (VPD) Outbreaks and Protecting Hard-Won Immunization Gains in WHO South-East Asia
articles.summary: The WHO Regional Office for South-East Asia organized a side event at the 79th Session of the WHO Regional Committee for South-East Asia (SEAR), in collaboration with the Ministries of Health of Bangladesh, Maldives, and Sri Lanka, the International Vaccine Institute (IVI), and The Hong Kong Jockey Club Global Health Institute (HKJC-GHI). The event drew more than 80 in-person participants, including RC delegations and immunization programme stakeholders from host country Timor-Leste, alongside over 50 virtual participants.
articles.summaryOriginal: The WHO Regional Office for South-East Asia organized a side event at the 79th Session of the WHO Regional Committee for South-East Asia (SEAR), in collaboration with the Ministries of Health of Bangladesh, Maldives, and Sri Lanka, the International Vaccine Institute (IVI), and The Hong Kong Jockey Club Global Health Institute (HKJC-GHI). The event drew more than 80 in-person participants, including RC delegations and immunization programme stakeholders from host country Timor-Leste, alongside over 50 virtual participants.
articles.summaryJa: WHO東南アジア地域事務局は、バングラデシュ、モルディブ、スリランカの保健省、国際ワクチン研究所（IVI）、香港ジョッキークラブ・グローバル・ヘルス研究所（HKJC-GHI）と協力して、第79回WHO東南アジア地域委員会（SEAR）のサイドイベントを開催した。このイベントには、開催国東ティモールからのRC代表団や予防接種プログラム関係者を含む80名以上の直接参加者と、50名以上のバーチャル参加者が集まりました。

articles.headline: WHO South-East Asia Region commits to stronger action to close gaps to end TB
articles.headlineJa: WHO東南アジア地域は結核撲滅に向けたギャップを埋めるためのより強力な行動を約束
articles.summary: Member States of the WHO South-East Asia Region today committed to stronger, more integrated action to close critical gaps to end tuberculosis (TB), focusing on earlier diagnosis, better access to prevention and treatment, stronger financial protection for families, and readiness for new TB vaccines.
articles.summaryOriginal: Member States of the WHO South-East Asia Region today committed to stronger, more integrated action to close critical gaps to end tuberculosis (TB), focusing on earlier diagnosis, better access to prevention and treatment, stronger financial protection for families, and readiness for new TB vaccines.
articles.summaryJa: WHO東南アジア地域の加盟国は本日、早期診断、予防と治療へのより良いアクセス、家族への経済的保護の強化、新しい結核ワクチンへの備えに焦点を当て、結核（TB）撲滅に向けた重大なギャップを埋めるためのより強力で統合された行動に取り組むことを約束した。
